scope: AI-generated educational concept illustrations, not experimental evidence

prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: article cover illustration for Leafcoin, an English-language agrotech R&D concept site. Produce ONE landscape 3:2 editorial 3D illustration, not a collage, not a photograph claiming a real installation. Primary scene: a believable small tabletop aeroponics module in a calm home research workshop. Three lettuce and basil plants supported in individual collars above an opaque dark root chamber with a clean educational cutaway in its front wall. Fine cream-colored roots hang freely in a large air space; directed fine sprays from two small visible side nozzles gently wet roots. The bottom has a sloping drain and a separate modest nutrient reservoir beside the module, a practical pump, filter and simple supply/return tubing. The chamber is not filled with liquid, no roots submerged in a water tank. A slim warm-white grow light above. Style: sophisticated restrained high-tech + agrotech, realistic botanical detail, matte forest-green and charcoal equipment, brushed metal, subtle pale green light, natural healthy foliage, warm off-white water highlights; deep green background and soft side daylight. Elevated three-quarter view, strong clear silhouette, all essential objects in central 85%, natural breathing room. No text, labels, logos, watermarks, people, coins, holograms, visible claims or yield comparisons.
